page.layout: One page of text. Running head centred at top, page number at top left. Main text in one column, with a small-type quotation block set apart and a heading between the sections. Marginal notes in the left margin (a bracket note "Supra in hoc Cap." and the section marker "Sect. XXII."). No text below the main text.

main_text.p: Episcopos, gaudemus; quod si quis audaciter & inconsulte ad fovendas pestes exarserit, Ministri Dei (Meipsum dico) executione audaciae suae poenas dabit. Haec Constantinus. Ut multa paucis complectar. Constantinus Imp. Episcopos à se iudicandos esse non censuit: at Episcopi ipsi censuerunt. Illis non in Causis dogmaticis, at in Criminalibus; nec in tempore non suo, at in opportuno, quùm sedata omnia; nec tunc in tyrocinio suo Niceae, at post, animo maturus & aevo, Aegypti, Tyri, Nicomediae, iudicium authoritatemque suam interposuit. Hactenus de testimonijs ipsis; quibus ad extremum Coronidis loco additur à Bellarmino, vz.
main_text.head: Bellarminus de Offic.
main_text.p: “Si haberemus Sanctos Episcopos, non egeremus huiusmodi testimonijs, ipsa enim sacra potestas, cum vera sanctitate coniuncta, cogit ad sui veneration em non solum Principes minores, sed etiam summos. — pag. 41.
main_text.head: I. ANIMADVERSIO.

head.i: Bellarminum, in urgendis Testimonijs, non quicquam profecisse.

main_text.p: Sect. XXII.Cuiusmodi, obsecro, testimonijs? nam quae hactenus protulisti Nazianzenum, Chrysostomum, Ambrosium, Gregorium Authores & testes sanctos, & plane divinos habuerunt, & Caussae Regiae Patronos disertissimos: quos tamen producere soletis, ut Episcopis, si forte in summa Sacra via Reges conveniant, locum honorificentiorem; si palatia ingrediantur, praecedentiam deberi probetis; & posse Eos Principibus non excommunicatis Subiectionem suam negare; Excommunicatis Coronam detrahere. Hæc hæc est hodierni Papismi Arx præcipua. Proh hominum væcordiam! longè aliter Nazianzenus;Supra in hoc Cap. {*}Magistratus, inquit, nobis praesunt. {*}Episcopi (inquit) Regibus subditi. Ambrosius, {*}Sacerdotes (inquit) secularibus potestatibus debent esse subiecti. Gregorius, {*}Imperatori (inquit)

page.notes: The three asterisks in the text are reference marks matched to the left-margin bullets; the brace note "Supra in hoc Cap." is a single margin note set against the first mark. The running head contains the printed chapter marker "Cap. 6" at top right, which is omitted from running_head because it is a number. The quotation block lines each begin with a printed quotation mark; the first is kept as one paragraph. Italic boundaries in the first paragraph and the spelling "væcordiam", "Hæc hæc", "veneration em" (printed "veneratio-nem" split across the line, rendered here as "veneration em" and should be checked) are read from a low-resolution scan and may be imperfect.
